subtitle: Customer Complaint Intake Form: customer complaint intake, investigation, and recovery using customer account, customer statement, and communications.
title: Customer Complaint Intake Form
use_case: Use the intake form during customer complaint intake, investigation, and recovery when the customer complaint record must identify customer account, contact, product or service, transaction, channel, affected location, and prior complaint history. Complete the applicable handoff for approved response, customer confirmation, credit or corrective action, root-cause referral, trend coding, and closure.
